title: Pause chip overlaps the forecast panel whenever window width < 1220px
detail: Chip right edge is win_w/2+360; forecast starts at win_w-250. They collide unless win_w > 1220. The comment promises resize tracking, no clamp exists, and the PR only verified 1280×720.
recommended_fix: Clamp chip.x to min(win_w/2+240, win_w-250-124), or anchor to a guaranteed-free screen edge, so the chip never covers the forecast panel.

title: Chip background is a magic color literal while border and text use the palette
evidence:
+            rl.DrawRectangleRec(chip, rl.Color{238, 230, 210, 255})
+            rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(chip, 1, p.ink_soft)
+            draw_text(&app, "PAUSED", i32(chip.x) + 8, i32(chip.y) + 4, 12, p.ink_soft)
detail: The same chip mixes a hard-coded background literal with palette ink_soft for border/text. PR claims 'styled like the existing tray chips'; a literal silently drifts from that style.
recommended_fix: Replace {238, 230, 210, 255} with the palette field the existing tray chips use for their backgrounds.

title: Replaced pause-overlay rendering has zero automated coverage
evidence:
+   **No app-level overlay test was added: the harness captures never include
+   the app overlay** (the overlay is app-layer-only, drawn in `main.odin`,
detail: The only pause-state UI was rewritten with bespoke, untested geometry. An off-screen, overlapping, or missing chip passes the entire green suite; the rationale itself concedes this.
recommended_fix: Extract the chip rectangle/text placement into a pure proc and unit-test its geometry (including non-overlap with the forecast panel across win_w values).

title: 'Edits stay live while paused' affordance hint deleted with no replacement
evidence: -            draw_text(&app, "P / Space to resume - draw, place, demolish, QoS all live", WIN_W/2 - 292, WIN_H/2 + 14, 18, rl.Color{235, 224, 192, 255});
detail: Pause-and-plan's key discoverability signal — that edits remain live — existed only in the deleted hint. The new two-line chip gives the player no equivalent information.
recommended_fix: Surface the live-edit affordance elsewhere (HUD hint line, chip tooltip, or onboarding) so players know planning works while paused.
